name: ▼Slime Musume wa Ningen to Tomodachi ni Naritai Youda
original_name: ▼スライム娘は人間と友達になりたいようだ
source:
"Hello, human! Nice to meet you! Will you be my friend?"

Aura, a young slime girl, is eager to make friends with a human. Having never left the forest and facing opposition from her forest companions, Aura's hopes seem dim. However, one day, she encounters a wise rose that offers her advice. 

Will Aura be able to find friendship with a human after all?
